researchInterests: Deepfake detection, audiovisual representation learning, speech recognition, self- and semi-supervised learning, and robustness.

details: Serve as the primary model designer for speaker verification, audio deepfake detection in telephony, and audiovisual deepfake detection.
Design and apply self-supervised learning methods and develop personalised deepfake detection methods.
Investigate model robustness to unseen generators, telephony distortions, noise and dataset shifts, and contribute to training data generation.
Deliver internal talks explaining the group’s models and research to colleagues across the bank.

appointments.title: Postdoctoral Researcher
details: Developed a unified model for audio, visual and audiovisual speech recognition; first-author paper at ICLR 2026.

Introduced an efficient pseudo-labelling method that approximately halved training time versus the previous model (NeurIPS 2024) and improved robustness to longer utterances, noise and unseen domains.

appointments.title: Research Scientist Intern
details: Developed large-scale semi-supervised models for auditory and visual speech representations, leading to first-author publications at ICLR and NeurIPS.

appointments.title: External Research Collaborator
details: Developed a scalable self-supervised model for joint speech and facial representation learning.
Supervisor: Prof. Maja Pantic. Funded by an Imperial President’s PhD Scholarship.
education.thesis: Learning from Talking Faces: From DeepFake Detection to Speech Recognition
education.research: Developed deepfake detection methods that generalise to unseen forgery types and remain robust to video corruptions.
